text.n1: Have you ever wondered if you can open your iPhone with your mirror reflection?
text.n2: When the phone is awake, these cameras fire over thirty thousand dots
text.n3a: straight onto the face, and the infrared camera picks up the pattern.
text.n5: But here's the twist: a mirror bounces that light straight back onto my face.
text.n3c: So what's the phone really reading? My nose bends the dots one way, my cheeks another, and from those bends, it maps my face.
text.n3d: That's why a flat photo fails. Nothing bends.
text.n4: It also grabs an infrared picture, then checks both against the face I set up.
text.n4b: No match, it stays locked. A match unlocks it.
text.n6r: It unlocked for me! Did yours? Tell me in the comments.
